summary: Emera Incorporated filed a Form 6-K notifying the redemption of all $1.2 billion of its 6.75% Fixed-to-Floating Subordinated Notes Series 2016-A due 2076. The redemption date is June 15, 2026, at 100% of principal plus accrued interest. This is a routine debt redemption, not a special situation. No special-situation category applies.
